title: Superseded architecture note
description: A published-but-superseded architecture note kept as the stale related-target so the demonstrator can render a real superseded status marker.
markdown:
# Superseded architecture note

This note describes an earlier approach that has since been replaced. It is kept
published — rather than deleted — so that a `related` reference pointing at it
resolves to a real page whose `doc_status` is `superseded`.

Because `resolveRelated` fails the build on a dangling reference, the stale-target
status marker (FR-005) needs an actual superseded page to point at. This is that
page: the [blocks demonstrator](/architecture/blocks-demonstrator/) links here to show the
superseded marker on a Related card.
